dataformat.name: swiftMx
dataformat.title: SWIFT MX
dataformat.description: Encode and decode SWIFT MX messages
dataformat.label: dataformat,transformation,finance

marshalIn.description: A Prowide MX message, such as an MxPacs00800108, as unmarshal gives. The body is not converted: MX XML text fails

marshalOut.description: The MX XML, or JSON with writeInJson, in the stream cache, or a byte array when stream caching is off

unmarshalIn.description: An MX message, read as UTF-8

unmarshalOut.description: The Prowide class of the message by its namespace (or readMessageId), such as MxPacs00800108; null when the type is not detected

writeInJson.description: Whether to marshal messages in JSON format.

readMessageId.label: advanced
readMessageId.description: The type of MX message to produce when unmarshalling an input stream. If not set, it will be automatically detected from the namespace used.

readConfig.label: advanced
readConfig.description: Refers to a specific configuration to use when unmarshalling an input stream to lookup from the registry.

writeConfig.label: advanced
writeConfig.description: Refers to a specific configuration to use when marshalling a message to lookup from the registry.
